windowsCoverage.accounting: Nine complete successful files from the original full run plus one complete fourteen-case file retest, counted once per file against unchanged frozen source. Original failed run is retained. This is not a single clean full run or an Actions release gate. Preliminary cases, the original thirteen passes in the retried file, WSL and compatibility probes do not add to coverage totals
